messages.-特殊沈潜\n-基本値:0,最大値:15\nこの効果の威力を生きた蝶、回数を死ん:
Special Sinking
Default: 0; maximum: 15
This effect's Potency is The Living; its Count is The Departed.
When taking damage, heal the attacker's SP by The Living ÷ 4 (minimum 1, rounded down).
If SP is below 0 when taking damage, take Gloom damage equal to Sinking Potency ÷ 5 for every 1 The Departed (maximum Gloom damage: 30, rounded down; halve this damage against targets without SP).
At Turn End, reset The Departed to 0. Inflict Sinking equal to The Living, then convert The Living into The Departed.
External effects cannot increase this effect's infliction amounts. Extra Sinking infliction effects add Sinking instead of extra Butterfly.
Remove this effect when both The Living and The Departed reach 0.

messages.戦闘開始時、生きた蝶・死んだ蝶をそれぞれ10ずつ保有。\n生きた蝶・死んだ蝶を消:
At the start of battle, hold 10 each of The Living and The Departed.
When consuming The Living & The Departed, randomly consume The Living (Potency) and The Departed (Count).
When inflicting Butterfly, apply the following according to the ammunition consumed by that Coin:
- If The Living was consumed, inflict The Living equal to the amount consumed.
- If The Departed was consumed, inflict The Departed equal to the amount consumed.
If The Living & The Departed runs out during a skill, cancel all remaining Coins and Reload.
When Reloading or gaining The Living & The Departed, the Butterfly type gained depends on current SP.
- At 0 or more SP, gain The Living with a 30% chance and The Departed with a 70% chance.
- Below 0 SP, gain The Living with a 70% chance and The Departed with a 30% chance.
Roll separately for each bullet.
※Active while deployed in battle
